name: tiktok-monitor
description: Portable TikTok monitoring plugin that runs the repository collector through CloakBrowser and the monitor CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Run TikTok monitoring cycles through CloakBrowser
interface.longDescription: TikTok monitor wraps the repository monitor CLI so Codex can refresh collection plans, run CloakBrowser-backed humanized collection, analyze snapshots, sync Feishu Base, and send operator-facing reports with one command.
defaultPrompt: Use TikTok monitor to run one full monitoring cycle.
Use TikTok monitor to check collection status.
Use TikTok monitor setup to review first-time configuration.
